top.text: 100% AI email automation is fragile. One hallucinated reply can break a SaaS relationship. Better pattern: AI → classify → pull context → draft Human → review → send Automate the preparation. Keep the human in the loop.
top.translationZh: 100% AI自动回邮件太不靠谱了。AI一旦胡言乱语回复一次，SaaS客户关系就完蛋。更好的做法：AI分类→调取上下文→起草内容，然后人工审核→发送。让AI做准备工作就行，关键决策还得人来把关。
